metadata.name: Neon Spire
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A vertical cyberpunk district at night, built from the Neon Megacity style pack: wet streets under neon signs and holographic billboards, a glass elevator up the 31 m Spire to the sniper roost, two three-storey blocks joined roof to roof by a sky tram, and a skytrain loop 12 m up where hover cabs lap all match and run down anyone on the deck. Cut the neon from the Kowloon roof for a 12-second blackout.

do.text: Neon Spire. Skytrain cabs do not stop: mind the deck.
Blackout! The neon is down for 12 seconds.
